scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
